theorems.statement: (∀ (m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) 0) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (0 + 1)), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (0 + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) 0), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin 0 → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) 0) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (0 + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → ∀ (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) 0) (ψ₀ ψ₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) 0), (∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin 0 → Eucl m), (ψ₀ : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) 0) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) 0) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → (∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin 0 → Eucl m), (ψ₁ : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) 0) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) 0) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z.boundary ψ = X ψ₁ - X ψ₀) ∧ (∀ (m j : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (j + 1 + 1)), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) ((j + 1) + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin (j + 1) → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) (j + 1)) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) ((j + 1) + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → ∀ (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (j + 1)) (ψ₀ ψ₁ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) j), (∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin (j + 1) → Eucl m), (ψ₀ : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) (j + 1)) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (j + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → (∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin (j + 1) → Eucl m), (ψ₁ : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) (j + 1)) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (j + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin j → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) j) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (j + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z.boundary ψ = X ψ₁ - X ψ₀ - ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X.boundary (φ s)) ∧ (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Z η = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s)) → ((∀ (j : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) (j + 1)), k = j + 1 → HEq Y X → Y.boundary.mass < ∞) → Z.boundary.mass < ∞))
